recipient.legal_name: Volunteers in Medicine - San Francisco dba Clinic by the Bay

finance.note: Primary unaudited IRS filing, not an audited portfolio allocation or current marginal cash budget. Do not subtract all noncash contributions from expenses as if automatically matched, or infer cash flow from accrual figures. Gross cost includes event expense netted from revenue. Depreciation is a resource-use allowance, not a cash outflow.

gift_usd.basis: Hypothetical ordinary unrestricted gift; not a quoted tranche.

funding_additionality.basis: Fraction expanding or preserving otherwise-lost care after replacement of existing donors; distinct from alternative care after treatment starts.

dental_allocation.basis: Fully loaded ordinary-gift share for all dental work, not just painful teeth; judgment from new two-day dental service within broader medical clinic.

mental_allocation.basis: Fully loaded ordinary-gift share for counseling and psychiatry; specialty spending not disclosed.

medical_allocation.basis: General medical, chronic care, prescriptions and referral support; health left unquantified.

food_other_allocation.basis: Food pharmacy and remaining services; health left unquantified. All four shares sum to one.

dental_episode_cost.basis: Average fully loaded cost per nominal all-dental course, not only selected extraction. Target and non-target shares partition that activity; non-target budget feeds residual model without adding donor cost. Salary-oriented prior, not measured throughput.

mental_course_cost.basis: All-in mental-health course budget, independent prior: roughly eight funded/coordinated contacts at $150, including overhead and unsuccessful attempts; not clinic quote.

dental_target.basis: Share of dental courses with severe pain and clinically indicated simple extraction; no credit to cleanings/exams/fillings here.

mental_target.basis: Share of mental-health courses suitable for short-term counseling of depressive symptoms; exclude psychiatry-only and unsupported diagnoses.

dental_completion.basis: Completed definitive care conditional on initiated target course; no credit to emergency exam alone.

mental_completion.basis: Fraction reaching an adequate local counseling dose; full attempt costs retained.

dental_unique.basis: Unique patient-period fraction; repeat teeth and repeat episodes excluded from additional utility summation.

mental_disjoint.basis: Unique counseling patient-period fraction after excluding every dental-credited person and repeat courses; unknown linked-data prior.

dental_capacity.basis: Maximum additional completed unique target patients in gift cohort; unverified capacity prior.

mental_capacity.basis: Maximum additional completed disjoint counseling patients; unverified capacity prior.

dental_utility.basis: Signed relief utility prior, loosely oriented by nonsignificant Swedish extraction before/after EQ5D .77 to .81; not a causal estimate.

dental_resolution.basis: Successful pain resolution conditional on completed extraction, separate from course completion.

dental_catchup.basis: Annual no-gift alternative-treatment/spontaneous symptom-resolution hazard, conditional on successful early treatment; central mean .25 years before hard cap.

dental_horizon.basis: Hard maximum years of earlier relief after care begins, never lifetime.

dental_delay.basis: Years until care starts; cohorts conditioned alive at start, delay discounts only.

dental_harm.basis: Gift-date PV incremental procedural/tooth-function QALY loss per additional completed unique patient; net of eventual alternative-care harm.

mental_utility.basis: Signed initial counseling utility advantage: independent prior, NOT Beck-score to EQ5D conversion.

mental_fidelity.basis: Local effect-size transfer prior among adequate-dose completers; no claim clinic replicates trained trial therapists.

mental_catchup.basis: Additional local alternative-care attenuation beyond imposed one-year fading; accounts for accessible public/free mental care.

mental_horizon.basis: Counseling utility fades linearly to zero by one year after start; no residual lifetime mental-health benefit.

mental_delay.basis: Care start delay, discounts only for an alive-at-start cohort.

mental_harm.basis: Gift-date PV incremental burden/adverse effects per additional completed unique counseling patient; clinical deterioration already in signed utility excluded.

mortality.basis: Annual competing all-cause hazard during finite benefit, not a mortality reduction claim.

bay_share.basis: Direct Bay Area fraction; intended clinic catchment; no measured marginal residency split.

sf_share.basis: Direct SF subset of Bay Area; weak prior from SF and San Mateo mission, not proof clinic location equals resident location.

volunteer_resource_per_donor.basis: Additional gross associated volunteer opportunity-cost allowance per donor dollar, not a clinic valuation or incremental net cost.

external_resource_per_donor.basis: Outside support for original dental/mental branches and common patient support only; BP/residual per-course allowances exclude these costs.

independent_harm_q.basis: Gift-date PV QALY loss independent of expanded care; separate from per-patient harms.

bp_medical_fraction.basis: General-medical budget fraction for HDFP-like hypertensive adults ages30–69/DBP≥90; unknown local case mix, not all visits.

bp_course_cost.basis: Fully loaded annual systematic-care cost: six contacts at$200 plus$300 drugs/labs; multiply by max(1,funded years), so longer care never costs only one year.

bp_unique.basis: Unique annual patients after excluding dental/counseling patient-periods and repeats.

bp_baseline_hazard.basis: Current-care all-cause annual mortality prior near annualized HDFP referral arm, not untreated mortality.

bp_relative_hazard.basis: Constant-hazard approximation from HDFP5y risks6.4%stepped versus7.7%community referral; not observed first-year HR.

bp_modern_gap.basis: Remaining opportunity relative to historical referral comparator after modern public/free access, not fraction never treated.

bp_delivery_transfer.basis: Implementation relative to trial assignment effect; no second multiplication by absolute trial adherence.

bp_active_years.basis: Funded exposure; hazards equal comparator after this period.

bp_latency.basis: Initial delay before any hazard effect within the funded exposure.

bp_horizon.basis: Finite survival followup after care start; no permanent risk reduction.

bp_delay.basis: Discount-only start delay, cohort alive at service start.

bp_utility.basis: Utility among living high-risk cohort, independent prior.

bp_harm.basis: Gift-date PV nonfatal incremental treatment harm; fatal effects already inside signed mortality contrast.

bp_external_per_course.basis: Annual outside BP clinical/patient-time cost, multiplied by max(1,funded years); donor-paid and common original-branch support excluded.

residual_unique.basis: Unique residual patient-periods after excluding all credited cohorts/repeats; full costs retained.

residual_capacity.basis: Unknown additional unique annual-course capacity prior.

residual_delay.basis: Discount-only delay; cohort alive at start.

residual_harm.basis: Gift-date PV incremental harm outside signed utility, per additional unique course.

boundaries.numerator: Whole ordinary-gift cost and attempted expected direct-health portfolio, including uncertain residual morbidity; not an exhaustive consequences inventory.
boundaries.overlap: Dental patients first; counseling excludes those patient-periods entirely. No general chronic-care utility is additionally credited to these patients.
boundaries.public_baseline: No government receipts does not imply no public/free alternative care. Healthy SF covers primary and mental care, not routine dental; other dental clinics still matter.
boundaries.resources: Gross associated donor plus volunteer and external resource allowance, not net incremental societal cost or exhaustive induced public costs.
boundaries.timing: Cohorts alive at care start. Delay discounts benefits only; harms already gift-date PV. Finite utility integration, no mortality prevention.
boundaries.room: No priced additional patient tranche verified. Capacity and funding additionality are scenario priors.
boundaries.unavailable: 2025 annual report linked via Canva returned unsupported-browser content; no financial or specialty counts inferred from unread pages. Displayed annualreports-page counts lack verified year and are unused.
boundaries.historical: Retain existing clinic-dental-cea-v1.json selected extraction model ($933,333 per10Q central) unchanged as historical comparison.
boundaries.residual: Remaining budget after selected dental,counseling and BP shares feeds one residual morbidity model. Rare preventive tails remain uncertain, not provenzero; residual and expectation-weight stress required.

expected_value.method: Subjective joint scenario mixture; ratio to expected signed Q, not average positive-only ratios.
expected_value.basis: Subjective elicitation, not empirical frequencies: documented ongoing care and waiting demand put most mass on some added but partly replacing activity; central70% represents existing-provider alternatives and mixed clinical need. Favorable15% is a correlated high-need/volunteer-capacity state (severe case mix makes more targets and longer waits, available volunteer capacity lowers course cash cost), not independent success of every optimistic parameter. Cautious10% represents largely low-burden/already-served patients and weak effective delivery; structural null5% reserves complete displacement/no additional activity despite existing operation. These exact probabilities are judgment calls with no calibrated reference class; broad0–30% favorable-weight stress is required, and85%of meanhealth can come from15%tail. They are not evidence of specific funding room.
